result.summary: Confirmed via docker exec psql + zig build test-integration-exp/svc/env that: (1) test-integration-svc and test-integration-env are both aliases of the same tests/integration/main_test.zig aggregate (53 distinct failing tests, not the narrow ~19 GH-375 named); (2) this broad umbrella is already comprehensively tracked under GH-482 (open, filed 2026-08-06, same affected files including exp201_202_entities_test/env01/env02/env03/svc01_service_catalog_scope_test); (3) the entity-subsystem slice (test-integration-exp, 13 tests, 5 failing) is cleanly isolable and has a single, well-diagnosed root cause not previously identified in GH-482's own description (which names a different dominant symptom: missing tenant_<uuid>.schema_migrations ledger). Decision: fix the entity-subsystem slice in this run; leave the rest to GH-482's existing tracking rather than duplicate.
